content.short: Loozr is a social music streaming service that allows you to trade, invest, and access Listen2Earn.
content.description: Loozr fuses DeFi concepts with music trading to address core challenges in the music industry. It targets higher, faster artist payouts, instant payouts for creators, and an open, transparent royalty and streaming accounting system. By promoting decentralization and democratization of industry participation, ownership, and crowd-investing, Loozr works across Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and Arbitrum to broaden access and align incentives for creators, investors, and fans alike.
